_comment: RuneLite settings the engine depends on. Only these keys are compared against the active profile. 'required' mismatches are logged as warnings when a bot starts; 'recommended' ones at info level. 'default' is the value RuneLite uses when the key isn't in the profile (omit if unknown). Values are compared as strings; colours are RuneLite's signed ARGB ints.
